verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs include pages on creating recurring charges ('Crea un cargo recurrente'), managing scheduled charges ('Maneja tus cargos calendarizados') and external subscriptions, so recurring billing is a first-party capability. The evidence is only page titles, though, and says nothing about plan objects, trials, upgrades/downgrades, or proration. Missing for 10: plan/pricing-tier management, trial periods, subscription upgrades/downgrades, proration logic, in-depth docs content, and independent corroboration.
